integrity: Exact dual face enumeration, two fully checked acyclic Morse matchings, integer Smith factors, mod-two cross-check, signed orbit representation, and deterministic standalone code. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: One fixed regular seven-vertex consecutive-difference tournament; reduced integral homology and rational cyclic action only. A homotopy wedge decomposition, arbitrary odd-order extension, full automorphism-module classification, and external certification are not asserted.
title: Three-degree integral homology and cyclic symmetry of a seven-vertex tournament multipath complex
